# SES v1

Send and verify email with the classic SES Query API over the same state as SES v2.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `ses` |
| Signing name | `ses` |
| Wire protocol | AWS Query |
| API version | `2010-12-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Recorded delivery |
| Selected operations | 23 of 71 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#ses-v1) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No SMTP or real outbound email delivery.
- Configuration set event destinations, tracking, delivery and reputation options, receipt rules, identity policies, notification and MAIL FROM settings, and custom verification emails are not implemented.
- SendEmail rejects ReturnPath, SourceArn and ReturnPathArn; sending authorization is not evaluated.
- DescribeConfigurationSet returns only the name, and GetSendStatistics reports hourly rather than 15-minute data points with no bounces, complaints or rejects.
- Identity verification is immediate; domain verification tokens are derived from the domain.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
